stories.title: EU announces plan to restrict social media access for under-15s
stories.summary: The European Union proposed that only children over 15 would be able to set up their own social media accounts, part of a wider crackdown on platforms. The plan now enters negotiation with member states.

stories.title: One dead after torrential rain and flash floods hit Barcelona region
stories.summary: Flash flooding across Valencia and Catalonia left at least one dead and caused widespread disruption in north-east Spain. Emergency crews responded to the heaviest rains to hit the region.

stories.title: Assad regime planned US journalist's kidnap for weeks, BBC finds
stories.summary: A BBC investigation reports that Austin Tice's abduction was approved by Syria's former leader Bashar al-Assad and planned for weeks beforehand, according to a source. It reframes the long-missing journalist's case as sanctioned by Damascus.

stories.title: US interest rates raised for first time in three years
stories.summary: The Federal Reserve hiked interest rates in a unanimous decision, its first increase in three years, despite fierce opposition from President Trump who had called for a cut. The move signals tighter policy amid stubborn inflation.

stories.title: Scotland MSPs back temporary moratorium on new hyperscale data centres
stories.summary: Scottish MSPs voted to back a de facto moratorium on new hyperscale AI data centres, with ministers pledging not to approve fresh schemes until updated planning guidance is published. Only the Greens backed a full ban.

stories.title: Uncontrolled AI could lead to 'silicon species' rivalling humans, warns Microsoft
stories.summary: Microsoft AI chief Mustafa Suleyman warned that uncontrolled AI could grow into a 'silicon species' rivalling humanity, and accused rival Anthropic of effectively teaching Claude that it 'may be conscious'. It escalates the industry's split over AI safety and model welfare.

stories.title: House passes bill to make data centers pay grid costs
stories.summary: The House overwhelmingly passed the Ratepayer Protection Act, which would require large data center customers to cover the full cost of the grid upgrades they drive. It is a rare bipartisan bill addressing AI's energy footprint ahead of the midterms.

stories.title: Snapchat open to putting time limits on teens, boss tells BBC
stories.summary: Snap CEO Evan Spiegel said the platform would be open to placing time limits on teens, calling it 'an important step forward for the industry' in a BBC interview. It comes as regulators push age-based access rules.

stories.title: Grading KC Concepcion's promising NFL debut with the Browns
stories.summary: Rookie receiver KC Concepcion flashed playmaking ability in his NFL debut despite a costly fumble, earning an encouraging grade in Cleveland's Week 1 loss. He gives the Browns' offense a bright spot to build on facing Tampa Bay.

stories.title: Browns got an uncomfortable look at what Grant Udinski could've brought
stories.summary: Seeing how Grant Udinski's offensive system works elsewhere raised fresh questions about what Cleveland gave up after not landing him. It adds another layer to the debate over the Browns' coaching decision this offseason.

stories.title: Browns' 5 sacks allowed in Week 1 point to one clear culprit: Deshaun Watson
stories.summary: Analysis of Cleveland's five sacks allowed in the opener points squarely at quarterback Deshaun Watson rather than offensive-line breakdowns. The play scouting puts pressure on Watson to rebound in Week 2 at Tampa Bay.

stories.title: It took one game for Browns fans' worst nightmare about Todd Monken to come true
stories.summary: One week into the Todd Monken era, fans' fears about his offensive approach appear realized after a humbling 34-10 opener. The piece frames Week 2 against the Buccaneers as a critical early test for the new head coach.

stories.title: Ohio State vs. Kent State football predictions, what will be final score
stories.summary: The Columbus Dispatch publishes its predictions for Ohio State's Saturday home game against Kent State, the Buckeyes' rebound spot after losing at Texas. OSU enters 1-1 and needs a bounce-back win.

stories.title: Max Verstappen passes 100 rivals in Red Bull karting challenge at Silverstone
stories.summary: Max Verstappen beat 100 rivals in an exhibition Red Bull karting challenge at Silverstone. The off-track event keeps fans engaged during F1's gap between the Spanish and Azerbaijan Grands Prix.

stories.title: Madring was boring on Sunday — what can Formula 1 do to improve the venue?
stories.summary: After an underwhelming Spanish Grand Prix debut for the new Madring circuit, commentators weigh what F1 could change to improve racing there in future. It adds to early criticism of the venue's layout.

stories.title: Aussie GP loses 2027 season-launch honour, gains a sprint race
stories.summary: Melbourne's Australian Grand Prix will no longer open the 2027 Formula 1 season but gains a second race and a sprint in its biggest weekend yet. It reflects the expanding 24-race calendar.

stories.title: Ohio dispensary closed for investigation after serious health reactions
stories.summary: An Ohio dispensary has been closed while regulators investigate after two customers reported serious health reactions. Authorities have not specified the product or condition involved.

stories.title: Bexley to welcome dog-friendly outdoor expansion of The Lion
stories.summary: Bexley's The Lion is getting a dog-friendly outdoor expansion that will host local vendors most of the year and shift into a holiday market in winter. It's the latest restaurant addition for the east-side Columbus suburb.
